Amphictyon Networks demo logins (http://localhost:8080)

Every user has the same password, generated on your machine by install.sh.
Read it with: task password   (or: cat deploy/compose/.local/demo.env)

  admin         Zeus      Runs the whole platform.
  engineer      Daedalus  The builder. Edits flows and standards.
  noc           Argus     The hundred-eyed watcher. Runs flows, cannot approve them.
  approver      Themis    Law and order. Approves or rejects changes.
  auditor       Clio      Muse of history. Reads everything, changes nothing.
  athens-admin  Pericles  Runs Athens. Sees Athens and the shared standards only.
  sparta-admin  Leonidas  Runs Sparta. Sees Sparta and the shared standards only.
